{{Top|leg}}
A '''radar beacon''' was a simple [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]] that was installed on [[para-wing glider]] used by tourists on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]. The radar beacon allowed the para-wing glider to be found in case the pilot accidentally got lost or ran into trouble.
